description: Work with variable data sets on the active document: import them from a text file (File > Import > Variable Data Sets), apply one (Image > Apply Data Set), or save a PSD per data set into a folder (File > Export > Data Sets as Files). Variables themselves are defined in Image > Variables > Define

filePath.description: import: absolute path of the comma- or tab-delimited text file

firstColumnNames.description: import: use the first column as the data set names. Default false

names.description: export: the data sets to save, each as <name>.psd

replace.description: import: replace the existing data sets. Default true

name: manage_data_sets
title: Manage Data Sets
